architecture: Simulink/MATLAB produces raw evidence (trajectory v1, high-rate audit v1, controller trace v1, source-selector telemetry v1, terminal record) -> OFFLINE authoritative python FC-3 adjudication (ppe.fc3_core.fc3_check over sanitized view + raw evidence)

legacy_checker.retained_role: writes simulation_terminal_status (v2 classification) into terminal records and records the native E_unserved integral (violations.shortfall_energy_kWh) used as the sanitized-view payload input
cannot: exclude a voyage from effect eligibility
legacy_checker.enforcement: genB freeze binds fc3_authoritative.sha256=33a8309a and the loader rejects any freeze whose fc3_authoritative points elsewhere (PPE:E3B:FC3; negative regression N1_R6_v2_authority_rejected PASS); G2 acceptance consumes readjudicated_status only

acceptance_rule: A G2 run enters the authoritative corpus only if ppe.fc3_core.fc3_check(view, traj, audit).readjudicated_status == READJUDICATED_FEASIBLE over its preserved raw evidence

raw_evidence_replayability.evidence: attempt-A diagnostic readjudication re-adjudicated 61/61 completed runs from existing 1 Hz trajectories + high-rate audits + terminal records WITHOUT any Model-E re-run (_audit_stop_gate / ep3_readjud_a_out.txt)
